name: Conformance: WASM Pack Memory-Cap Breach (Positive Path)
description: RFC 0008 §K fixture. Invokes `vendor.openwop.misbehaving.memory-bomb`, whose module grows linear memory until the host refuses. A host advertising nodePackRuntimes.wasm.maxMemoryBytes MUST stop it, emit `cap.breached` with `kind: 'wasm-memory'`, and end the run `failed`. The operator installs the pack from `conformance/fixtures/wasm-packs/misbehaving-memory/` (hand-written WebAssembly, no Rust toolchain needed). Fixture-only; not signed for the registry.
